summary: Allocates and initializes a new slab for a custom heap allocator. If the slab descriptor array is full (dword_8D48F8 == dword_8D48E8) it grows the array via HeapReAlloc (capacity +16). It then allocates a descriptor slot, a 0x41C4-byte bitmap/free-list metadata block via HeapAlloc, and reserves a 1MB slab via VirtualAlloc, initializing descriptor fields (slot[0..2], bitmap head) and incrementing the active-slab counter dword_8D48F8. Returns the descriptor pointer, or 0 when any allocation fails (freeing earlier allocations on failure). Called by sub_59416F (0059416f) on the frame path.

local_names.v0: current active-slab count dword_8D48F8 read as the descriptor slot index
local_names.v1: HeapReAlloc result pointer for the grown descriptor array
local_names.v2: descriptor slot pointer computed as lpMem + 20 * v0
local_names.v3: bitmap/free-list metadata block allocated by HeapAlloc

operations.description: If dword_8D48F8 == dword_8D48E8 (descriptor array full), grow it by calling HeapReAlloc(hHeap, 0, lpMem, 4 * (5 * dword_8D48E8 + 80))
HeapReAlloc(hHeap, 0, lpMem, 4 * (5 * dword_8D48E8 + 80)) grows the slab descriptor array; on a NULL return the function returns 0
After a successful grow: dword_8D48E8 += 16 (raised capacity), lpMem = v1 (new array base), v0 = dword_8D48F8 (re-read active count)
Compute descriptor slot pointer v2 = (char *)lpMem + 20 * v0 (20-byte stride per descriptor)
HeapAlloc(hHeap, 8u, 0x41C4u) allocates the bitmap/free-list metadata block stored at v2[4]; on NULL return the function returns 0
VirtualAlloc(0, 0x100000u, 0x2000u, 4u) reserves the 1MB slab address space stored at v2[3]; on NULL return it frees the bitmap block (HeapFree(hHeap, 0, v2[4])) and returns 0
Initialize the descriptor: v2[2] = -1 (free-block sentinel), v2[0] = 0, v2[1] = 0, increment dword_8D48F8 (active slab count), and set the bitmap head *v2[4] = -1
Return v2 (the new slab descriptor pointer) on success, or 0 on any of the three allocation failures
Invoked by sub_59416F (0059416f) on the frame path to obtain a fresh slab when the heap needs capacity
